correctness.rationale: Two specified distinct domain points determine a unique signed affine extension; rank-one nonfixed maps are counted only as translations and the empty map only once. For shift d>0 the n-d domain positions split into b_d residue strings of length a_d and d-b_d of length a_d-1. A k-arrow path exists exactly at a selected k-run, and concatenating zero-terminated blocks and a final run yields the rational forbidden-run series. A nilpotent reflection omits fixed points and uses at most one point of each transposed pair, so each nonempty such restriction has index two. Its polynomial removes ranks zero and one to avoid duplication. The pair-count levels below floor(n/2) occur four times each for positive levels, with multiplicities one or three at the top; summing the binomial coefficients gives the stated parity formulas (n=1 directly gives only zero as nilpotent). The ambient order gives a limiting density, not an exact density, of 1/3. The non-translation contribution is O(3^(n/2)) while nonzero translations number 2^(n+1)-2n-2. Within translations the absolute shift has a uniformly geometric tail. At each fixed shift, a union bound over at most n starts rules out runs longer than (1+epsilon)log_2 n with high probability; at least n/(2r) disjoint length-r windows for r=floor((1-epsilon)log_2 n) make a shorter maximum improbable. Conditioning on nonempty domains does not affect this limit, and the index is one plus the maximum run. Independent bounded literal composition checked the joint counts, closed counts and ambient order through n=9. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/87e35433-f3e4-0fba-83d6bdce1f8a/independent_census_check.py 9. Those checks do not establish the asymptotic claim on their own.

evidence: The full ensemble adds precisely the rank-at-least-two nilpotent reflection restrictions to the uniform order-preserving support. Their number is bounded by (2n-1)3^floor(n/2)=o(2^n), whereas the known order-preserving count is 2^(n+1)-2n-1.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: For nested finite supports, the total variation distance of their uniform laws is the fraction of elements outside the smaller support. It tends to zero here, and the same index map is used on both supports. Thus the prior ratio limit, and even the corresponding sharp law along lattice subsequences, transfers without a new limit theorem. Retelling the longest-run proof does not create an uncovered contribution.

evidence: For each shift d the prior lengths floor((n-j)/d), 1<=j<=d, are b_d copies of a_d and d-b_d copies of a_d-1. Its B counts the same forbidden words as A.
